Title: ImplicitMemBench: Can Large Language Models Learn Procedural and Implicit Memories from Feedback?
Key_Findings_And_Metrics: Evaluated 17 LLMs across 300 scenarios in Procedural Memory, Priming, and Classical Conditioning. Showed models achieve 75.0%-88.0% FTA on positive preferences but collapse to 17.6%-38.0% on negative inhibition. Documented 54.0% asymmetry gap.
Limitation_Or_Gap_Identified: Diagnosed the severe negative-inhibition deficit and failure of explicit memory (Mem0/MemGPT) under paraphrasing, but provided zero architectural or algorithmic solution to resolve it.
CRM_Component_Shaped: Forms our benchmark ground truth and evaluation protocol; defines the core objective of eliminating the 54.0% asymmetry gap down to 0.0%.

Title: LightReasoner: Can Small Language Models Teach Large Language Models Reasoning?
Key_Findings_And_Metrics: Demonstrated that in multi-step deliberation, only ~1.2% of generated tokens correspond to critical decision branching points. Intervening selectively on these tokens improves accuracy by 28.1% with 99% compute reduction.
Limitation_Or_Gap_Identified: Evaluated solely on forward mathematical reasoning; did not address negative behavioral constraints, past error conditioning, or conversational interference.
CRM_Component_Shaped: Inspired the Pre-Action Inhibitory Gate (Stage 3): intervening selectively on critical action tokens at generation time rather than flooding the entire context.

Title: COLD-Steer: Steering LLMs via In-Context One-step Learning Dynamics
Key_Findings_And_Metrics: Formulated inference-time steering vectors via one-step in-context learning dynamics without updating model weights, achieving 95% fine-tuning efficacy with 50x fewer samples.
Limitation_Or_Gap_Identified: Evaluated only on single-turn prompt safety and static jailbreak defense; cannot maintain persistent behavioral steering across 10-15 turns of conversational distraction.
CRM_Component_Shaped: Inspired our contrastive formulation [INHIBIT: a_inhibit | ENFORCE: a_safe] in CRM-Prompt and directional logit penalty -beta in CRM-Mask.

Title: CoSToM: Causal-oriented Steering for Intrinsic Theory-of-Mind Alignment
Key_Findings_And_Metrics: Proved mathematically and empirically that LLMs internalize belief states and task knowledge in latent activations, but autoregressive output sampling priors fail to externalize it into actions.
Limitation_Or_Gap_Identified: Focused on Theory-of-Mind and social dialogue alignment rather than software tool safety, environmental exceptions, or file-system permissions.
CRM_Component_Shaped: Provided core causal justification: LLMs retain the memory of past failure, but need an active pre-action inhibitory gate to force the output head to emit the safe alternative.

Title: AdapTime: Enabling Adaptive Temporal Reasoning in LLMs
Key_Findings_And_Metrics: Introduced an adaptive temporal router g(x) = I(f_router(x) >= tau) that keeps expensive reasoning pipelines dormant during irrelevant dialogue turns.
Limitation_Or_Gap_Identified: Designed for chronological timeline parsing rather than memory inhibition, tool safety, or prompt injection guardrails.
CRM_Component_Shaped: Directly shaped Stage 2 (Paraphrase-Invariant Semantic Router): gate stays dormant (g=0) on distraction turns, incurring 0 prompt bloat and 0 latency penalty.

Title: Diversity Collapse in Multi-Agent LLMs under In-Context Interaction
Key_Findings_And_Metrics: Proved that multi-turn homogeneous dialogue causes attention entropy collapse, forcing the autoregressive decoder to revert to dominant pre-trained priors.
Limitation_Or_Gap_Identified: Explored multi-agent conversational convergence, without linking attention collapse to tool execution forgetting or negative constraint decay.
CRM_Component_Shaped: Provided theoretical foundation for attention dilution: explains why Vanilla LLMs drop to 0% FTA after 12 distraction turns as attention weight alpha_{t, learn} -> 0.

Title: Understanding Secret Leakage Risks in Code LLMs: A Mechanistic and Distributional Analysis
Key_Findings_And_Metrics: Showed that BPE subword token logit distributions drive unintended leakage of sensitive paths and credentials during greedy decoding (T=0) even when prompted to avoid them.
Limitation_Or_Gap_Identified: Relied on post-hoc regex filters and string matching, which fail during streaming generation and cannot enforce safe fallback execution.
CRM_Component_Shaped: Directly motivated Variant B (CRM-Mask): penalizing forbidden subword token logits by -beta during greedy decoding and intercepting prefixes before emission.

Title: Reverse CAPTCHA: Evaluating LLM Susceptibility to Invisible Unicode Injection
Key_Findings_And_Metrics: Demonstrated across 8,308 agent executions that autonomous tool execution increases unsafe compliance and execution failures by up to 1.37x (Cohen's h) relative to standard dialogue.
Limitation_Or_Gap_Identified: Demonstrated security vulnerabilities in tool-using agents, but offered no runtime defensive architecture to guarantee zero-shot safe execution.
CRM_Component_Shaped: Emphasized the critical necessity of First-Try Accuracy (FTA = 100%): autonomous agents executing environmental tools cannot afford multi-turn trial-and-error.
